PromptFeeder.description: Feed text prompts from a folder one at a time (edit or library mode).

mode.name: mode
mode.tooltip: edit (type directly) / library (pick files) / single_file (pick one file, use start_index/end_index for a line range)

text.name: text
text.tooltip: One prompt per line. Empty lines are skipped.

source_root.name: source_root
source_root.tooltip: Data source. Registered external paths (via the library's Settings) are read-only (for reusing existing prompt/wildcard .txt files from other node packs).

directory.name: directory
directory.tooltip: Subfolder name within the selected source_root. Leave empty to use its root directory.

file.name: file
file.tooltip: Filename (e.g. hero.txt) within the directory above. Used in single_file mode; start_index/end_index then select a line range within this file.
